card.title: A Sign We’re Fine
card.instruction: Interpret every laugh, favor, and familiar habit as evidence that the connection is stronger than appearances suggest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You gave me my chipped plate. We're still us, even with your bags packed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you gave it to me. Still looking after me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Eat before it gets cold. The gravy's separate, like you prefer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered the gravy too. I'll set your place. We can discuss the bags over dinner.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 reads the familiar plate as continuing connection despite packed bags, A3 interprets ordinary serving as care, and A5 treats remembered gravy as grounds for shared dinner.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's only-clean explanation becomes A3's still-gave-it-to-me inference; B4's gravy preference causes A5's invitation to discuss the bags together.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects the plate significance while B4 still shows plausible practical care over food and preferences.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's real remembered habit to seek a shared conversation without denying the packed bags.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes imminent departure signs and a familiar dinner plate; B4 specifies the food arrangement.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's set-your-place choice grows from B4's care rather than adding unrelated optimism.
